name: Castle Point

housing: Castle Point is mostly suburban, with a high share of owner-occupied bungalows and semis in Benfleet, Thundersley and Hadleigh. Canvey Island is low-lying land behind sea walls, with many bungalows and chalet-style homes. Flats are mostly found over shops on the main roads and in small modern blocks. Many residents commute to Southend, Basildon and London.
checkinTips: Canvey Island homes sit on low-lying land behind sea walls: photograph floors, skirting boards and gardens for damp or signs of past flooding.
Bungalows: check loft hatches, roof and gutter condition you can see, and any conservatory roofs and seals.
Coastal homes near the Thames estuary: look for salt corrosion on metal gates, window fittings and outdoor taps.
Flats over shops on Hadleigh and Benfleet main roads: note the separate entrance, fire alarm, stair lighting and the number of keys handed over.
Family houses on the hills of Thundersley and Daws Heath: photograph garden fences, sheds and any trees close to the house.
tenantHelp: Tenants with disrepair, damp or safety problems in a privately rented home can contact Castle Point Borough Council's private sector housing or environmental health team.
